failure_types.label: missing_memoization
failure_types.description: Fail to cache repeated subproblems.

failure_types.label: pointer_mismanagement
failure_types.description: Lose, overwrite, or misadvance a pointer in linked structures.

failure_types.label: null_pointer_access
failure_types.description: Dereference or use an absent node/value without checking.

failure_types.label: incorrect_indexing
failure_types.description: Read or write the wrong index or slice.

failure_types.label: duplicate_handling_error
failure_types.description: Fail to skip, merge, or count duplicates correctly.

failure_types.label: edge_case_omission
failure_types.description: Miss a degenerate or boundary input case.

failure_types.label: incorrect_binary_search_bound
failure_types.description: Move the low/high bound incorrectly and lose correctness.

failure_types.label: wrong_partitioning
failure_types.description: Split items around the pivot or threshold incorrectly.

failure_types.label: wrong_sliding_window_update
failure_types.description: Update the window in the wrong order or miss a shrink/expand step.

failure_types.label: wrong_prefix_sum_usage
failure_types.description: Misuse cumulative sums or range offsets.

failure_types.label: incorrect_backtracking_restore
failure_types.description: Fail to restore state after exploring a branch.

failure_types.label: graph_traversal_miss
failure_types.description: Skip a node, neighbor, or component during traversal.

failure_types.label: invalid_topological_order
failure_types.description: Produce an order that violates dependency constraints.

failure_types.label: wrong_greedy_choice
failure_types.description: Make a locally attractive choice that blocks the optimal outcome.

failure_types.label: integer_overflow
failure_types.description: Exceed numeric range or fail to guard large accumulations.

failure_types.label: queue_management_error
failure_types.description: Mismanage queue order, enqueue/dequeue timing, or breadth-first state.

failure_types.label: stack_underflow
failure_types.description: Pop from an empty stack or lose nesting context.

failure_types.label: wrong_hash_key
failure_types.description: Use the wrong key or normalization in hash-based logic.

failure_types.label: failed_pruning
failure_types.description: Keep exploring branches that should have been cut.

failure_types.label: ordering_error
failure_types.description: Apply updates in the wrong sequence or violate a required order.

failure_types.label: missed_visited_mark
failure_types.description: Fail to mark explored states and revisit them repeatedly.

failure_types.label: missing_null_check
failure_types.description: Skip a required empty or absent-value guard.

failure_types.label: incorrect_recursive_transition
failure_types.description: Recurse into the wrong subproblem or combine children incorrectly.

failure_types.label: incorrect_dp_transition
failure_types.description: Define the wrong recurrence or DP state update.

failure_types.label: infinite_loop
failure_types.description: Fail to converge because a pointer, index, or state never moves correctly.

failure_types.label: wrong_relaxation_update
failure_types.description: Relax shortest-path edges in the wrong direction or order.

failure_types.label: wrong_distance_initialization
failure_types.description: Initialize distances or unreachable values incorrectly.

failure_types.label: negative_cycle_missed
failure_types.description: Fail to detect or report a reachable negative-weight cycle.

failure_types.label: wrong_mst_edge_choice
failure_types.description: Choose the wrong edge when building a spanning tree.

failure_types.label: wrong_segment_tree_merge
failure_types.description: Merge or propagate segment-tree node values incorrectly.

failure_types.label: incorrect_coordinate_compression
failure_types.description: Compress coordinates inconsistently and break index mapping.

failure_types.label: wrong_reservoir_update
failure_types.description: Update the sample reservoir with the wrong probability or replacement logic.

failure_types.label: wrong_randomized_partition
failure_types.description: Partition or sample randomly in a biased or invalid way.

failure_types.label: wrong_bitset_state
failure_types.description: Encode or update bitmask states incorrectly.

failure_types.label: wrong_parent_reconstruction
failure_types.description: Reconstruct parents or paths incorrectly during backtracking or shortest paths.

failure_types.label: path_reconstruction_error
failure_types.description: Reconstruct an answer path incorrectly from stored predecessor state.

failure_types.label: wrong_k_way_merge_order
failure_types.description: Merge multiple sorted streams in the wrong order or with stale pointers.

failure_types.label: incorrect_failure_function
failure_types.description: Prefix-function or failure-link computation is wrong.

failure_types.label: incorrect_palindrome_radius
failure_types.description: Palindrome radius expansion stops too early or overshoots.

failure_types.label: wrong_rolling_hash_collision_handling
failure_types.description: Rolling hash collisions or modulus choices are mishandled.

failure_types.label: suffix_structure_construction_error
failure_types.description: Suffix array or automaton construction breaks invariants.

failure_types.label: scc_lowlink_error
failure_types.description: Low-link or component bookkeeping is incorrect.

failure_types.label: eulerian_edge_reuse_error
failure_types.description: An edge is reused, skipped, or consumed in the wrong order.

failure_types.label: wrong_sieve_marking
failure_types.description: Composite marking or prime iteration is incorrect.

failure_types.label: prime_factor_missed
failure_types.description: A prime factor or multiplicity is omitted during factorization.

failure_types.label: wrong_matrix_exponent_order
failure_types.description: Matrix multiplication order or power decomposition is incorrect.

failure_types.label: merge_sort_split_error
failure_types.description: Recursive split or merge step loses ordering or elements.

failure_types.label: bucket_assignment_error
failure_types.description: Bucket ranges or insertion logic are incorrect.

failure_types.label: deque_window_mismanagement
failure_types.description: Stale elements are not removed or candidates are misplaced in a deque window.

failure_types.label: line_sweep_event_order_error
failure_types.description: Events are processed in the wrong sweep order.

failure_types.label: wrong_orientation_check
failure_types.description: Cross-product or orientation sign is computed incorrectly.

failure_types.label: wrong_cache_eviction
failure_types.description: The cache evicts the wrong entry or updates recency or frequency incorrectly.

failure_types.label: heap_rebalance_error
failure_types.description: Heap sizes or ordering are not restored after updates.

failure_types.label: order_statistic_misalignment
failure_types.description: Rank or order statistic queries are returned from the wrong position.

failure_types.label: wrong_modular_arithmetic
failure_types.description: Modulo arithmetic or overflow handling is incorrect.

failure_types.label: kadane_state_reset_error
failure_types.description: Running subarray state is reset at the wrong time or not at all.

failure_types.label: monotonic_queue_invariant_break
failure_types.description: The monotonic order or stale expiration invariant is violated.

failure_types.label: incorrect_hashmap_usage
failure_types.description: Hash-map lookup or update logic is applied incorrectly.

topic_hierarchy.description: Top-level learning map for the recommendation system.
Array and string mechanics, including windowing and indexing.
Linked lists, stacks, queues, and pointer-heavy state.
Tree traversal, BST reasoning, and heap-based selection.
Connectivity, traversal, ordering, and shortest-path problems.
Binary search, ordering, partitions, and range reasoning.
State recurrence, memoization, and exhaustive search with pruning.
Math, bit tricks, SQL, and stateful design problems.
Problems that rely on fixed-size or complement-based pairing.
String windows, anagrams, and substring constraints.
Pattern matching, palindromes, and suffix structures.
Prefix and suffix accumulation or combination problems.
Connectivity, traversal, and shortest path problems.
SCC, Eulerian, and advanced directed-graph families.
Classic and answer-space binary search variants.
Merging, scheduling, and overlap reasoning.
Sorting, ranking, and selection families.
Sweep-line and computational geometry families.
State transitions, memoization, and tabulation.
Search, prune, and enumerate combinations and placements.
Bitmask and compact-state dynamic programming.
Primes, modular arithmetic, and recurrence acceleration.
Bitwise masks, subsets, and binary reasoning.
Group-by and window-function query reasoning.
Online maintenance, eviction, and bounded-memory design.

problem_traits.label: difficulty
problem_traits.description: Overall solve difficulty or expected cognitive load.

problem_traits.label: acceptance_rate
problem_traits.description: Popularity proxy from community solve rates.

problem_traits.label: frequency
problem_traits.description: How often the concept appears in practice or interviews.

problem_traits.label: implementation_length
problem_traits.description: How much code and bookkeeping the solution needs.

problem_traits.label: edge_case_density
problem_traits.description: How many boundary conditions the problem contains.

problem_traits.label: prerequisite_load
problem_traits.description: How much prior knowledge is needed before attempting.

problem_traits.label: novelty
problem_traits.description: How fresh or unfamiliar the underlying idea feels.

problem_traits.label: repetition_risk

problem_traits.label: solution_uniqueness
problem_traits.description: How many distinct valid solution approaches the problem supports.

problem_traits.label: branching_factor
problem_traits.description: How many distinct decision branches the solution explores.

problem_traits.label: state_space_size

problem_traits.label: implementation_depth
problem_traits.description: How much code or pointer state the solution needs.

problem_traits.label: runtime_criticality
problem_traits.description: How sensitive the problem is to time complexity improvements.

problem_traits.label: data_structure_pressure
problem_traits.description: How much the solution depends on maintaining a specialized structure.
